## Theventure

Launch a fund, close institutional capital, train for a VC career, or invest as an LP. Four free programs powering the next generation of ethical venture capital.

[Find your program](https://govclab.com/apply)

[Explore VC Lab](https://govclab.com/vc-lab)

Our Programs

## Choose your path.

Four programs, every stage of a venture career. Aspiring VC, launching Fund I, raising Fund II or III, or backing emerging managers as an LP. Pick your starting point.

![VC Lab](https://govclab.com/assets/vc-lab-DmkPjWtd.png)

![VC Lab logo](https://govclab.com/assets/vc-lab-CyS9bx6p.png)

Flagship Program

### VC Lab

Launch a VC Firm in 4 months.

Free flagship 14-week intensive accelerator for new and emerging managers fundraising and launching ethical VC firms. 920+ firms launched across >90 countries. No equity, no fees.

Learn more

[Apply Now](https://fi.co/apply/vc/home)

![Emerging Institute](https://govclab.com/assets/emerging-institute-DD0HzryS.png)

![Emerging Institute logo](https://govclab.com/assets/emerging-institute-CvarWa3Z.png)

### Emerging Institute

Raise from Institutions.

Free 8-week program for managers working on Fund II, III, or IV to close institutional LPs with 1:1 office hours, LP mentor access, and a Demo Day.

Learn more

[Apply](https://fi.co/apply/13473/emerging-home)

![LP Institute](https://govclab.com/assets/lp-institute-C58eaNpX.png)

![LP Institute logo](https://govclab.com/assets/lp-institute-ZDqgnOke.png)

### LP Institute

Become a Fund Investor.

Free, invitation-only experience for accredited investors, angels, and family offices to enter venture capital. Cohorts of 50 or fewer participants.

Learn more

[Apply](https://fi.co/apply/12385/about-lp)

![Venture Institute](https://govclab.com/assets/venture-institute-CrmxK13V.png)

![Venture Institute logo](https://govclab.com/assets/venture-institute-CwHtCTvn.png)

### Venture Institute

Start a VC Career in 9 weeks.

Free global program training the next generation of AI-native VCs, with Decile Hub Certification.

Learn more

[Apply](https://fi.co/apply/13242/home)

Why VC Lab

## Built for the new era of venture.

We are disrupting the friction, cost, and gatekeeping that defined the old model of venture. Join the future.

### Ethical by Design

We believe that the ethical operations of financing the future will lead to better outcomes for all.

### AI-Native

We see artificial intelligence helping talented investors and team members make better decisions.

### Truly Global

We know that there is amazing talent everywhere around the world that we want to support.
